notes.title: Don't Forget at the Belgian Game Awards!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We are proud to announce that Don't Forget has been nominated in the "Student Game Of The Year" category at the Belgian Game Awards!

The Belgian Game Awards show will be held at 9 PM CEST on October 18th on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/belgian_games]twitch[/url]!

Tune in on Friday to find out if Don't Forget wins Bronze, Silver or Gold!

Read more about the Belgian Game Awards and the nominees in the other categories here:
https://awards.belgiangames.be/
